comments.body_html:
I just tested the mod before this last update and was pretty cool but I immediately noticed an issue that I am not sure what exactly was the cause and don’t know if anyone else has experienced. Bare in mind I run multiple mods, most mods available so it would be hard to figure out though I have my suspicions.

Basically, as soon as I got into the vehicle my character seemed to be upside-down in the seat. At first I thought that somehow the bots from the Pit Team mod had gotten stuck on the car trying to follow me but it turns out it was my character. I fiddled around with the F12 settings and that’s how I figured it out. The real problem wasn’t that I couldn’t see, the real problem was that I couldn’t get out of the car because a revival menu appeared as soon as I got into the car which prevented me from finding the door handle and getting out of the car. I forgot to screen capture the issue. I was able to move my character’s body out of the way through the F12 settings but that didn’t fix the issue. I was basically stuck in the car because that revive menu would no go away and allow me to open the door. I believe the Bring Back To Life mod, which I only just now realized has been removed from the Forge website, could be the cause. Not sure why it was removed or when but I had it and still use it. Will test with and without and provide screen shots to show. Also, not sure how it works with the Pit Team mod. will check that as well.
